title: Looks used
text: Looks used. This item arrived to me in what looks like used condition. If that’s not the case and it’s never been used then this item is just beat up. The shelves are supposed to be frosted, several of them have scratches that have removed the “frostiness”. One of them had some kind of sticky thing on it, reminded me of a price tag. It’s not worth the price, keep looking.
